question: What is the fee structure?
answer: WeIntern course fees vary by program: Full Stack Web Development — ₹4,999 (12 weeks), Mobile App Development — ₹5,999 (10 weeks), AI & Automation — ₹6,499 (8 weeks), Cloud Solutions & DevOps — ₹5,499 (10 weeks), UI/UX Design — ₹3,999 (8 weeks), Digital Marketing — ₹2,999 (6 weeks), Data Science & Analytics — ₹6,999 (12 weeks). All fees are one-time and include certificate and live projects.

question: What are the course-wise fees?
answer: Course fees at WeIntern: Full Stack Web Development ₹4,999 | Mobile App Development ₹5,999 | AI & Automation ₹6,499 | Cloud Solutions & DevOps ₹5,499 | UI/UX Design ₹3,999 | Digital Marketing ₹2,999 | Data Science & Analytics ₹6,999. question: Which payment methods are accepted?
answer: WeIntern accepts payments through Razorpay, which supports UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), debit cards, credit cards, and net banking. You will receive the payment link during the enrollment process.

question: Is EMI available?
answer: EMI options may be available through Razorpay depending on your card or bank. Please contact support at +91 74149 74582 or contact.weintern@gmail.com to confirm EMI availability for your preferred program.

question: Are discounts available?
answer: Yes. WeIntern programs are already offered at discounted prices (20% off or more from original prices). Additional discounts or promotional offers may be available during certain enrollment cycles. Contact support at +91 74149 74582 for current offers.

answer: Refund terms depend on the official WeIntern refund policy and the timing of the request. For refund queries, contact the support team at +91 74149 74582 (WhatsApp) or contact.weintern@gmail.com with your enrollment and payment details.
